texts.2d6eaf20fc6e: Our principal research objective is to establish whether collaborative care is effective and cost-effective in reducing symptoms of sub-threshold depression in older adults compared with usual GP care alone Our secondary objectives are:1) Validate the Whooley Questions - the Whooley questions are regularly used in primary care as a screening tool for depression but it's validity as a tool for identifying depression in older adults in the UK has not yet been established.2) Establish the whether collaborative care is acceptable to older adults with sub-threshold depression and to the people delivering collaborative care.3) Tailor and develop collaborative care to meet the needs of older adults.Sub-clinical depression has been linked with decreased quality of life and has been identified as a clear risk factor for development of more severe depressive disorder. texts.c26110449a97: Collaborative care and active surveillance for screen positive elders with subclinical depression: a pilot study and definitive and randomised evaluation. (The CASPER Study). Our principal research objective is to establish whether collaborative care is effective and cost-effective in reducing symptoms of sub-threshold depression in older adults compared with usual GP care alone Our secondary objectives are: 1) Validate the Whooley Questions - the Whooley questions are regularly used in primary care as a screening tool for depression but it's validity as a tool for identifying depression in older adults in the UK has not yet been established. 2) Establish the whether collaborative care is acceptable to older adults with sub-threshold depression and to the people delivering collaborative care. 3) Tailor and develop collaborative care to meet the needs of older adults. Sub-clinical depression has been linked with decreased quality of life and has been identified as a clear risk factor for development of more severe depressive disorder. Currently there is no clear evidence base regarding treatment of subclinical depression in this patient group. Therefore this study has significant value and potential benefit for the public. Data access is restricted to those named in section 7 of this agreement. Any changes will be notified to the NHS IC.
